bible_quanes.question: Who joined Paul in greeting the Thessalonians?
What did Paul remember about the Thessalonians?
bible_quanes.answer: Your work of faith, labour of love, and patience of hope

bible_quanes.question: From what did the Thessalonians turn to God?
bible_quanes.explanation: To serve the living and true God.

bible_quanes.question: For whom do the Thessalonians wait?
bible_quanes.explanation: Who delivers from the wrath to come.

bible_quanes.question: How did the gospel come to the Thessalonians?
bible_quanes.answer: Not in word only, but in power, in the Holy Ghost and much assurance

bible_quanes.question: Whom did the Thessalonians become followers of?
bible_quanes.answer: Of us, and of the Lord

bible_quanes.question: To whom did the Thessalonians become examples?
bible_quanes.answer: All who believe in Macedonia and Achaia

bible_quanes.question: How far had the Thessalonians' faith gone out?
With what did the Spirit accompany the gospel?
With what did the Thessalonians receive the word?
bible_quanes.answer: Much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Paul aim to please?
How was Paul gentle among the Thessalonians?
bible_quanes.answer: Even as a nurse cherisheth her children

bible_quanes.question: How did the Thessalonians receive the word?
bible_quanes.answer: Not as the word of men, but as the word of God

bible_quanes.question: What is Paul's hope, joy and crown of rejoicing?
bible_quanes.answer: Even ye, in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming

bible_quanes.question: Where had Paul been shamefully treated before Thessalonica?
How did Paul support himself?
How did Paul exhort the Thessalonians?
bible_quanes.answer: As a father doth his children

bible_quanes.question: Who hindered Paul from coming?
What did Paul not use as a cloak?
What did the Jews forbid Paul to do?
bible_quanes.answer: Speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved

bible_quanes.question: Whom did Paul send to establish the Thessalonians?
What good news did Timothy bring?
bible_quanes.explanation: And their good remembrance of Paul.

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul pray will increase and abound?
bible_quanes.answer: Love toward one another and all

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul say about living?
bible_quanes.answer: We live, if you stand fast in the Lord

bible_quanes.question: Where did Paul stay alone?
What did Paul not want the Thessalonians to be shaken by?
What did Paul fear?
bible_quanes.answer: Lest the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain

bible_quanes.question: What did Paul pray night and day?
bible_quanes.answer: That we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul pray God will establish?
bible_quanes.answer: Your hearts unblameable in holiness at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ

bible_quanes.question: What had Paul told them beforehand?
What is the will of God, according to 1 Thessalonians 4:3?
How will the Lord descend from heaven?
bible_quanes.answer: With a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God
bible_quanes.explanation: The dead in Christ will rise first.

bible_quanes.question: Where will believers meet the Lord?
bible_quanes.explanation: And always be with the Lord.

bible_quanes.question: What should we do with these words?
By whom are the Thessalonians taught to love one another?
bible_quanes.explanation: No need for Paul to write.

bible_quanes.question: What should the Thessalonians aspire to?
bible_quanes.answer: Study to be quiet, do your own business, and work with your own hands

bible_quanes.question: How should believers not sorrow?
bible_quanes.answer: As others who have no hope

bible_quanes.question: Whom will God bring with Jesus?
bible_quanes.answer: Them also which sleep in Jesus

bible_quanes.question: How should each one possess his own vessel?
What will those alive at Christ's coming not do?
What does 1 Thessalonians 5:17 command?
In what should we give thanks?
How will the day of the Lord come?
bible_quanes.answer: As a thief in the night

bible_quanes.question: What does 1 Thessalonians 5:16 command?
What will people be saying when sudden destruction comes?
What should we put on as a breastplate and helmet?
bible_quanes.answer: The breastplate of faith and love, the helmet of the hope of salvation

bible_quanes.question: What should we not quench?
From what should we abstain?
What should we do with all things?
bible_quanes.answer: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good

bible_quanes.question: What does Paul pray will be preserved blameless?
bible_quanes.answer: Your whole spirit, soul and body
